craft_claim: Opening pages establish a binding implicit contract (reader promise) regarding tone, stakes, narrative distance, and emotional payoff.

supporting_evidence.location: Chapter 7: Play It Again, Sam, pp. 201-224
supporting_evidence.note: Burroway shows how beginnings establish the contract of style, subject, and form that the climax must honor.
